profile.headline: Web Developer Supervisor at Sun East Federal Credit Union

positions.title: Web Developer Supervisor
positions.description: As a Web Developer Supervisor I oversee the the development of Corporate Websites, Online Applications and Online/Mobile Banking solutions. This involves using System Development Life Cycle (SDLC) to evaluate, design, develop, test, implement, and maintain these web solutions. SDLC methodologies practices include, but are not limited to include prototyping, agile programming and rapid development. Additionally, I manage vendor relations, web server maintenance and security, and escalated issues regarding Online/Mobile Banking.

positions.title: Web Developer/Programmer
positions.description: I work in the eCommerce department as a web developer and programmer. I develop both internal and external web applications and mange the company web server. This includes but not limited domain management, database management, file management and security. Additionally I act as a technical consultant to online banking to include testing, enhancements, and implementations. I am sometimes called to task in assisting marketing with creating HTML emails, landing pages and web forms.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description: In the role I worked along side a team of system engineers for 18 months on the Megatouch Live project. I developed the user interface for Megatouch Live in WPF. After the project I became the principle web developer for a series of company websites. My responsibilities in this role include the following: UI Design/Development, Web Design/Development, Prototyping/Agile Programing, Web Content Management, Requirements Gathering, and Design Documentation.

positions.title: Web Developer/Systems Analyst
positions.description: The A&H Legal department sought after a solution to manage data and streamline their business processes. Their resolution was to develop a web-based application now known as the Resource Center. I was principal in the design, development, and maintenance of the Resource Center. In this role my responsibilities included the following; Data Architecture,  Web Design/Development, Report Development, System Analysis/Management, Data Analysis,Web Content Management, Requirements Gathering, and Design Documentation.

positions.title: Sr. Call Traffic Analyst
positions.description: The National Call Management Center monitors call traffic from multiple call centers to maintain company service level goals. Call traffic is monitored via dashboard and reported to senior level staff through an intranet portal. As a traffic analyst I handled daily call center management that included routing traffic and escalating additional staffing. I ran outbound dialer campaigns. At the senior level I designed and developed the call management system.
